designer.name: Elina Vale
designer.title: Graphic designer building identity systems that move like cinema.
designer.intro: A cross-disciplinary portfolio shaped around packaging, cultural campaigns, moving image, and tactile motion systems.
designer.about: The portfolio is structured as a design universe: a gallery of brand systems, launch visuals, and social campaigns staged as illuminated objects in orbit.

about.title: Design systems with editorial calm and a universe-scale point of view.
about.body: The practice combines branding, packaging, launch visuals, and motion systems. The emphasis stays on premium pacing, spatial composition, and tactile digital surfaces rather than fast, disposable content.

title: Experiments in type,
light, and motion noise.
playground.description: This page holds visual R&D that informs the portfolio language: shader surfaces, reactive particles, generative poster logic, and more speculative interface behaviors.

experiments.title: Generative Typography
experiments.caption: Letterforms that warp into fluid ribbons as the pointer moves.

experiments.title: Chromatic Sandstorm
experiments.caption: A lightweight particle field driven by curl-noise rhythms and scroll momentum.

experiments.title: Reactive Surface
experiments.caption: A shader plane with spectral distortion mapped to cursor intensity.
